fields.name: employee_name
fields.description: Full legal name of the employee.

fields.name: social_security_number
fields.description: Employee’s SSN as required on the W-4.

fields.name: filing_status
fields.description: Employee’s chosen filing status (e.g., Single, Married).

fields.name: extra_withholding
fields.description: Additional amount employee requests withheld from each paycheck, if any.

fields.name: exempt
fields.description: Indicates whether employee claims exemption from withholding.

fields.name: signature
fields.description: Signature of the employee certifying the form.

document.document_description: Form W-4 is a one-page IRS document employees in the U.S. fill out to let their employer know how much federal income tax to withhold from their pay. It typically includes personal information, filing status, and allowances or deductions claimed.
